File surface (read on `origin/main` `5cb6e6e0a`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the adopt-orphans arm (`POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans`, about `:2135`–`:2160`). It runs `requireManageMetadata` and `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, then `protocol.reassignOrphanedMetadata({ targetPackageId: id })`, and never calls `requireWritablePackage`. Every sibling write arm does (`:1410`, `:1602`, `:1629`, `:2114`, `:2267`, `:2365`).
- The shape follows the card's Wanted. The dev first reads `reassignOrphanedMetadata` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, about `:29044`) for its own writability check. If there is none, the arm calls `requireWritablePackage` before the protocol call, in its siblings' order, and answers `422 [writable_package_required]` the way #24705's arm does. Pins: a read-only package is refused and binds nothing; a writable package is unchanged.
- A changeset for `@objectstack/runtime`.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: `requireWritablePackage` / `isWritablePackage` themselves, `reassignOrphanedMetadata`'s binding rules, every other arm, objectui (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13181 already hides the action), and `packages/spec/**`.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Basis for the Clause-② line: the door refuses a request it accepted before (adopting into a read-only package). That narrows a public REST door's accept set and widens nothing. It owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue, and it stays in this lane.
Responsibility: this lane's runtime door (`packages/runtime`) mutates a package every sibling arm refuses to write (ADR-0070). No platform path covers it, unless `reassignOrphanedMetadata` checks writability itself, which the dev reads first. It is reachable by a `manage_metadata` holder through `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans`.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`. All 14 open PRs were read in this act.
- #24705's gate (PR #24719, `9b2953d62`) and #24670's arm (PR #24703, `f7005cbd8`) on the same file have landed.
- This seat's other cards in flight, #24738 (PR #24806) and #24827 (`migrate apply`), are disjoint.
